thread:
nora (PM): quick sync: customer feedback + internal ops show we need clearer admission control for Reserved Pools. proposal: expose "soft-burst" config + autoscale gating rules in Console so tenants understand fallback behavior.

 diego (Eng): tl;dr: we need two pieces: 1) a config surface for pool-level admission (soft vs hard limit, preemption policy), 2) telemetry & enforcement path in runtime.

 tasha (SRE): +1. ops gap right now is silent throttles during peaks. want explicit SLOs per pool and a visible "rejection reason" that surfaces to both Console and logs.

 mei (Product Ops): from onboarding calls: customers want predictable degradation semantics. some prefer queuing, others want fail-fast with informative errors. can we offer presets?

 diego (Eng): presets are good: "FailFast", "Queueable", "BurstAllowed". each maps to runtime behavior and billing. simplest MLP: presets + read-only status. advanced: allow custom policy JSON.

 ravi (Sales): customers like the ability to pick behavior per environment (dev vs prod). this helps upsell Dedicated tiers. also ask: can we restrict BurstAllowed to certain hours? e.g., business hours only.

 nora (PM): timeline ask: some pilots want this before end of quarter. propose MLP: Console UI (select preset), pool status view (current occupancy, queued count, recent rejections), and event stream for rejection reasons. No per-route breakdown in MLP.

 diego (Eng): implementation sketch: 1) config API: PATCH /api/v1/pools/:id/policy 2) status API: GET /api/v1/pools/:id/status 3) runtime enforcement hook in the admission controller that consults cached policy. caching TTL 30s.

```
PATCH /api/v1/pools/:id/policy
Payload:
{
  "preset": "Queueable",
  "burst_hours": "00:00-06:00",
  "preempt_policy": "least_recently_used"
}

GET /api/v1/pools/:id/status
200 OK
{
  "pool_id": "rsv-pool-42",
  "capacity_tokens": 1000000,
  "current_inflight_tokens": 412300,
  "queued_requests": 12,
  "recent_rejections": 23,
  "policy": "Queueable",
  "last_policy_sync": 1747004400
}
```

 mei (Product Ops): love the status API. design-bot, can you mock the status panel? small tile with a color band (green/yellow/red) based on used% and queued.

 design-bot: mock created. panel shows "Used 41% / Queue 12" and hover details with last 1h trend. will upload to #design. :art:

 tasha (SRE): security/ops checklist: audit trail for policy changes, owner contact in policy metadata, rate limits on status API, and a throttling knob for the admission controller so human ops can tilt behavior during incidents.

 diego (Eng): infra note: admission hook must be lock-free. plan: policy cache in memory with atomic pointer swap on update from central config service. fallback to default if cache miss.

 nora (PM): acceptance criteria for MLP: - console allows selecting a preset and saving - status API returns current occupancy + queued + rejection reasons - audit log entry on policy change - runtime enforces preset behavior in the majority of cases (>=95% match in canary) - doc page + short help text in Console.

 ravi (Sales): what about billing implications when BurstAllowed is enabled? need clear messaging and invoice linkage. customers worry about surprise charges.

 diego (Eng): link runtime events to billing events by tagging token consumption with "burst" label at ingestion. billing team to finalize SKU mapping.

 mei (Product Ops): risk: if billing lag exists, live Console numbers might differ from invoice by a few minutes/hours and upset customers. mitigation: show "last synced" timestamp and a short note about billing latency.

 tasha (SRE): on-call impact: if Queueable preset causes long tail latency we'll see paging. suggest soft SLA on queue length and an automatic fallback to FailFast when queue > threshold. make this configurable per pool.

 diego (Eng): good call. add "auto-fallback-threshold" to policy model. default disabled.

 nora (PM): rough effort estimates: Eng 5 dev-weeks (admission hook + API + cache + tests), UI 2 dev-weeks, Design 1 week, SRE work 1.5 weeks for runbook/telemetry, Docs/Support 1 week. total parallel ~6 weeks.

 ravi (Sales): can we ship a "pilot" mode earlier? even read-only status plus a manual policy change via SRE would unblock some customers.

 nora (PM): yes. Pilot plan: 1) status read-only in Console (2 weeks), 2) manual policy change by ops (SRE) behind support flow, 3) full self-serve MLP in 6 weeks.

 diego (Eng): blockers: dependency on central config service upgrades and tagging support in billing pipeline. if both go green, we can meet estimates.

 deploy-bot: admission-controller image build #520 passed at 1747003200.

 mei (Product Ops): decision needed: do we include per-tenant "carryover" for unused burst credits (i.e., soft-burst bank) in MLP? customers ask for it but it's billing-complex.

 nora (PM): hold for follow-up. not in MLP. we should prototype policy without carryover, collect feedback, then decide.

 tasha (SRE): final ops callouts: expose a debug endpoint for oncall that returns last N rejections, a safety toggle to force-failfast, and alert rules when pool used% > 85% for 5m.

 diego (Eng): will add metrics: pool_used_percent, pool_queue_length, pool_rejection_rate, policy_applied_rate.

 nora (PM): action items: diego create design + API PR draft, design-bot finalize mocks, tasha author runbook and alert recipes, mei coordinate pilot customers, ravi update sales plays. I'll create the roadmap ticket and mark MLP vs pilot milestones.

 ravi (Sales): I'll notify 2 pilot customers and ask if they'd opt into early access.

 nora (PM): any objections? otherwise i'll spin up tickets and include the acceptance criteria above.

 diego (Eng): no objections. starting spike tomorrow.

 deploy-bot: config-service deploy #129 succeeded at 1747004800.

 nora (PM): thanks team.
